facts.version_note: Frozen fact API exposes updated_at instead of numeric version.

Existing registry occurrences are removed, descriptor storage is cleared, unlimited default allocation limits and four-byte alignment are installed, and each descriptor is reinserted at the registry head. facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/robj:.sbss
facts.version_note: Frozen fact API exposes updated_at instead of numeric version.
facts.value: The section begins in an uninitialized-cache state with a null pointer and zero capacity. Its first expression evaluation transitions it to an allocated state, normally with capacity 100 floats; later evaluations reuse that allocation. If an expression requires more entries than the recorded capacity, evaluation reports the requested and allocated counts and panics rather than resizing. A memory-forget operation transitions it back to the null, zero-capacity state only when the cached pointer falls within the forgotten half-open interval, after which evaluation lazily recreates the default buffer.
